prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the scene in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the northbound roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling in the center lane when Vehicle 2 moved into their lane without signaling, causing the sideswipe. Driver 2 stated that they checked their mirror, believed the lane was clear, and began a lane change when contact occurred. No traffic control devices were malfunctioning, and weather and road surface were dry and clear. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and complained of pain on movement; they were evaluated on scene and declined transport. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 reported no injuries. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder. Citations were not issued at the scene pending review of the statements and any additional witness information.
